title: 🎥 Theft & a chase! The craziest AI video on the Ballon d'Or
key_facts: Yahoo Sports carries an English version, translated by AI from a German original, about a recently released, almost cinematic AI video on the Ballon d'Or.
The headline describes the video as full of theft and a chase.
The piece says the race for this year's men's Ballon d'Or is more open than in years.
It says the video runs almost three minutes and is 'pure entertainment', though not entirely free of 'AI slop'.
It jokes about why Raphinha is at the gala when he is not even on the shortlist.
It does not say who made the video or with which tools, and does not give the date of the gala.
quote_evidence: A recently released, almost cinematic AI video brilliantly sums up the spectacle.
Almost three minutes of pure entertainment, though unfortunately not entirely free of AI slop.
why_it_matters_hint: A light item: an AI-made video used to poke fun at football's biggest individual award.
notes: Only a 733-character blurb exists; it is the whole article. The original German outlet is not named in the text and a search found no other outlet carrying it. The video itself was not seen, so the description of its content rests on the headline and blurb.
